_comment: php-cs-fixer is intentionally installed as a standalone composer project under tools/php-cs-fixer/
(via the cs:* scripts) instead of as a require-dev dependency here. The 'prefix' script runs php-scoper
over the whole vendor/ on every install/update (see post-install-cmd / post-update-cmd). A require-dev
php-cs-fixer would therefore be rewritten under the AC\Vendor namespace on every dev build, and would
only be excluded from release zips by --no-dev. Keeping it in tools/ leaves it out of vendor/ entirely,
so it is never scoped by php-scoper and never shipped in the plugin.
